objective.name: sample.echo
objective.description: Seed capacity descriptor used for reflexive read and meaning projection

#root.role: Echo the message parameter into a structured result payload.

transformation_contract.morphing: An inbound message becomes an explicit echo result with derived length and uppercase projections.
invariants: sample.echo must remain bounded by its declared inputs, outputs, and effects.
Internal implementation strategy may vary, but the declared contract surface must remain stable.
success: sample.echo returns payload and matter effects consistent with the declared outputs when it succeeds.
Successful execution preserves the semantic change described by morphing.
failure: sample.echo fails when required inputs or matter contracts are not satisfied.
The capacity fails when the underlying runtime or wrapper cannot satisfy the declared contract.
notes: This contract constrains expected behavior and observable effects, not the internal implementation decomposition.
Humans and LLMs should interpret the capacity through the declared interface and semantic guarantees first.
